title: Who are the rakyat?
subtitle: Malaysia's population, ethnic make-up and age structure
question: What is the population of Malaysia, and who makes it up?
answer: Malaysia is home to 34.2 million people. Bumiputera make up 63.6% of the population, Chinese 20.0% and Indians 5.9%, with non-citizens about 9.9%. Selangor is the most populous state (7.2M), and the country has just crossed into an 'ageing society' — 8.0% are now 65 or older.

source.notes: Population total, ethnic composition and age structure are 2025 estimates; state breakdown is the 2023 estimate. Figures in millions of people. Shares are of the total population (citizens and non-citizens).

trend.note: The population by 5-year age band (2025). The base is narrowing — fewer children — while the top is slowly growing as Malaysia ages.

by_ethnicity.title: Who lives here — by ethnic group
by_ethnicity.note: Malaysia's population by ethnic group (2025). Bumiputera (Malays plus other indigenous peoples) are the majority.

by_state.title: Where Malaysians live — by state
by_state.note: Population by state (2023). Selangor alone holds more than 1 in 5 Malaysians.

takeaways: Malaysia has **34.2 million** people. **Selangor** alone is home to **7.2M** — more than 1 in 5 Malaysians.
By ethnicity: **Bumiputera 63.6%**, **Chinese 20.0%**, **Indian 5.9%** of the population; **non-citizens** are about **9.9%**.
Malaysia has crossed into an **'ageing society'** — **8.0%** are aged 65+, while the under-15 share has slipped to **21.6%**.
The biggest single age group is **20–24** — a large young-adult cohort — but the pyramid is narrowing at the base as birth rates fall.

faq.q: What is the population of Malaysia?
faq.a: Malaysia's population is about 34.2 million (2025 estimate), according to the Department of Statistics Malaysia (DOSM).

faq.q: What is the ethnic composition of Malaysia?
faq.a: Of the total population (2025): Bumiputera 63.6%, Chinese 20.0%, Indian 5.9%, with non-citizens about 9.9% and other citizens the remainder.

faq.q: Which is the most populous state in Malaysia?
faq.a: Selangor, with about 7.2 million people, followed by Johor (4.1M) and Sabah (3.6M).
